all_completion_and_external_effects_reso.mechanism: reproducible-build.json, pin-ledger.json and gate-manifest.json re-derive their own hashes, the manifest binds both record hashes, and the build command is recorded with B02's placeholder so no machine-local path enters a receipt

governing_schemas_authority_boundaries_f.mechanism: the pin ledger's field set is closed, every pin carries kind, subject, digest and source, a floating pin is refused by its own code, and the Shinka backend pin is recorded BLOCKED with digest null rather than invented

happy_negative_crash_resume_adversarial_.mechanism: a real uv build ran twice from a staged snapshot and the wheel and sdist are bit-identical under the inherited environment normalization only — no post-hoc byte rewriting and no member excluded from the comparison

no_candidate_model_prompt_backend_or_hoo.mechanism: the gate builds and compares; it promotes nothing, and the backend pin requirements come from the canonical manifest schema rather than from any backend's own claims
